notes: The publish is a JSON POST to the server root (`NTFY_URL`), not to `/<topic>`; the topic travels in the body.

scenarios.description: notify tool: JSON publish to NTFY_URL with topic, title and message (body plus "Thread: /chat/<id>"), Bearer NTFY_TOKEN; control characters stripped; default link is the current thread.
scenarios.name: notify_tool

scenarios.description: A 500 from ntfy is recorded as "ntfy 500", not raised.
scenarios.name: notify_failure

scenarios.description: scheduler.notify_skipped after a budget skip: no NTFY_TOKEN, so no Authorization header and no thread link.
scenarios.name: budget_skip
